bestBets.overview: We race at Doomben in Brisbane on Saturday, not only is it the first day of the month it's also the first day of a brand-new racing season, 2026-2027 promises to be a cracker, good luck to all! Track a soft (5) at scratching time this morning following a dry week, forecast today is for only a shower or two, upgrade likely. The meeting gets underway with a restricted affair over a mile plus, Clive's Glory sets up as the leader with 3, 4 & 10 parking handily. Can't get excited about any of these, some mix their form, others just not up to it. Down in weight SLIPSAIN?

raceTips.comment: It was solid first up effort from THINKING GOLD to finish second over the mile when kicking off for the new yard at the Sunshine Coast. The former Victorian boasts a strong second up record and the blinkers go on. BLUEPINOT won well over the 1350m here back in June but has been plain three subsequent runs. He drops back in grade and will relish stepping out to the mile. ADDITION failed to fire last start but was found to have lost a plate during the run. She’d been racing well prior and back in grade, she can improve. MOSTRO did enough when resuming at Rockhampton and will have taken plenty of improvement from the run. The rise in trip will suit and he’ll be strong late.
